StackPanel.TextBlock: 1. Forward ammunition stocks at Diego Garcia remain adequate for one major fleet action and limited follow-on strikes. Fremantle and Darwin can support repair of light to moderate battle damage but not rapid regeneration after catastrophic losses.2. Convoy scheduling has been compressed. Escorts detached for independent operations will materially increase risk to follow-on reinforcement shipping.3. Commanders are directed to balance offensive opportunities against sustained sea-lane protection requirements. A tactical victory that leaves the logistics chain exposed will be treated as an operational defeat.
